title: plan-level transitions (open → submitted → done)
task_body: Plans gain their own transition state, separate from the per-task FSM. The durability facade exposes plan transitions; the server route handles HTTP; the CLI command surfaces the verbs; i18n strings localise the user feedback. End-to-end test proves the wire path.
rationale: facade_plan_transitions owns the state machine; error and lib re-export; server route + error map HTTP; CLI surfaces; i18n localises feedback strings; e2e validates.
